messages:
maria_ops: Vendor (AtlasLogix) notified we have a partial RTV on 12 units from the 100-unit commitment. Need routing decision — crossdock to FRA depot or direct to vendor's EU refurb? Air expedite costs look steep. AWB: 123-ATX-9988

kai_infra: Can we absorb depot repair for 12 units? What's the SOW on refurbishment? :thinking:

maria_ops: Vendor says depot repair ETA 7-10 business days, air return to vendor ~5 days + customs, vendor charges per-unit inspection fee. They want decision by EOD.

luca_procurement: Pricing: vendor offered to cover inspection for DOA units but charge €150/unit handling for RTV. They also propose consolidating invoices — might help customs.

samira_sre: Heads-up — cluster capacity impact: losing 12 H100s shifts scheduling for APAC tests. Can we pull 6 from reserved pool and delay non-critical jobs? :chart_with_downwards_trend:

maria_ops: Suggested split: 6 -> internal depot (repair), 6 -> vendor RTV (air). Need AWB generation and customs HS code confirmation. Vendor requires proforma for RTVs.

vendor_contact (AtlasLogix): we can accept 6 via depot, 6 via AWB. HS code for GPUs is 8471.70.00. We need invoice reference and serial list.

maria_ops: sending serials now. Quick note: some serials are mismatched in our manifest; see small snippet:
```
expected: H100-ABCD-1002
reported: H100-ABCD-1003
```
Need vendor to confirm serial acceptance policy. @vendor_contact (AtlasLogix)

vendor_contact (AtlasLogix): will accept as long as batch manifest includes original build order + photos. For mismatches we'll open a reconciliation ticket.

kai_infra: Logistics question: crossdock to FRA depot will reduce transit time but adds a handling surcharge of €40 per unit. Air direct to vendor includes brokerage fee ~€70/unit. Which is cheaper overall considering vendor handling?

luca_procurement: Quick calc: depot repair path (surcharge+internal repair labor) ~€120/unit. Air RTV+brokerage ~€220/unit. So depot route is cheaper but increases MTTR.

samira_sre: If depot repair MTTR is +8 days, our rollback plan should provision ephemeral GPU burst for APAC tests. Ops can patch in reserved capacity for 10 days. Confirmed?

maria_ops: ops ok to borrow 6 from reserved pool. I'll reply to vendor: proceed with split, vendor to provide AWB for 6 units, we'll crossdock 6 to FRA depot. Need proforma for vendor's records and PO ref.

maria_ops: tagging @luca_procurement for PO ref generation and @kai_infra for crossdock label prints. :thumbsup:

luca_procurement: PO 2026-APAC-RTV-09 created, attaching proforma now.

kai_infra: printing labels, will send courier manifest to vendor and ops-bot when ready. ETA for pickups: tomorrow 08:00 local. :truck:

ops-bot: pickup scheduled: 2026-02-14T08:00:00Z - courier: RapidAir AWB placeholders: `RAPID-000612`, `RAPID-000613`

maria_ops: thanks everyone. vendor to confirm acceptance + serial reconciliation ticket number once received. I'll update the cluster calendar.

vendor_contact (AtlasLogix): Received proforma and serials. Opening recon ticket #ALX-4217. Will share AWBs and customs docs once labels are scanned. Thanks.
